title: Kissed Crispy Portuguese Oats Fritters
description: A crispy and jammy Portuguese dish featuring oats, perfect for midnight cravings, made kosher-friendly and cooked to a golden brown in an air fryer.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together oats, flour, sugar, and cinnamon.
In a separate bowl, whisk together eggs and milk.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
Heat the air fryer to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Using a cookie scoop, drop the oat mixture into the air fryer basket, leaving about 1 inch of space between each fritter.
Cook the fritters for 5 minutes, shaking the basket halfway through.
While the fritters are cooking, heat the jam in a small saucepan over low heat.
Once the fritters are cooked, brush them with the warmed jam.
Serve the fritters warm and enjoy.
If desired, drizzle with additional jam and sprinkle with cinnamon.
